verdict.rationale: Baseten is a model inference and training platform, so a training-data opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no statement about data-use policy, training opt-out, or data retention. The training docs describe users training their own models, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
